summary: Security vulnerability (GHSA-3pv8-6f4r-ffg2) in tar crate 0.4.45 used by the Python SDK bridge causes PAX header desynchronization issues. Fixed by upgrading to tar 0.4.46.
userImpact: Users scanning Docker images with security tools like Trivy will encounter medium-severity vulnerability warnings in their deployment pipelines.
rootCause: PAX header desynchronization issue in tar crate version 0.4.45
proposedFix: Upgrade tar crate dependency from version 0.4.45 to version 0.4.46 in Cargo.lock
resolutionDetails: Upgraded tar dependency to 0.4.46 in PR #1564
keyQuote: tar has a PAX header desynchronization issue
